name: Taobao: daily price-change alerts by email

nodes.name: Apify: Taobao catalog
nodes.notes: Calls the Apify API (run-sync-get-dataset-items). Needs a Header Auth credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN>. Change maxTotalChargeUsd to cap spend per run.

parameters.content: Setup: Header Auth credential for Apify (Authorization = Bearer <Apify token>); SMTP credential and from/to addresses. To use Slack instead, replace the Send email node with a Slack node and map text to a plain-text version. Edit keywords, or use categoryIds / shopIds. First run saves a baseline (all items 'new', no email). Keep priceHistoryStoreName stable.
